title: DLMF 1.7 Inequalities: In this subsection A and B are positive constants.
summary: DLMF 1.7 Inequalities: In this subsection A and B are positive constants.
body: NIST DLMF section 1.7 (Inequalities) says: "In this subsection A and B are positive constants. Equality holds iff a_{j}=cb_{j} , \forall j ; c=\text{ constant} . Conversely, if \left(\sum^{n}_{j=1}a_{j}b_{j}\right)^{2}\leq AB for all b_{j} such that \sum^{n}_{j=1}b_{j}^{2}\leq B , then \sum^{n}_{j=1}a_{j}^{2}\leq A . For p>1 , \dfrac{1}{p}+\dfrac{1}{q}=1 , a_{j}\geq 0 , b_{j}\geq 0 , Equality holds iff a_{j}^{p}=cb_{j}^{q} , \forall j ; c=\text{ constant} . Conversely, if \sum^{n}_{j=1}a_{j}b_{j}\leq A^{1/p}B^{1/q} for all b_{j} such that \sum^{n}_{j=1}b_{j}^{q}\leq B , then \sum^{n}_{j=1}a_{j}^{p}\leq A . The direction of the inequality is reversed, that is, \geq , when 0<p<1 . Equality holds iff a_{j}=cb_{j} , \forall j ; c=\text{ constant} . In this subsection a and b ( >a ) are real constants that can be \mp\infty , provided that the corresponding integrals converge. Also A and B are constants that are not simultaneously zero. Equality holds iff Af(x)=Bg(x) for all x ." Equation 1.7.1 on the page has alt text "\left(\sum^{n}_{j=1}a_{j}b_{j}\right)^{2}\leq\left(\sum^{n}_{j=1}a_{j}^{2}% \right)\left(\sum^{n}_{j=1}b_{j}^{2}\right).". Equation 1.7.2 on the page has alt text "\sum^{n}_{j=1}a_{j}b_{j}\leq\left(\sum^{n}_{j=1}a_{j}^{p}\right)^{1/p}\left(% \sum^{n}_{j=1}b_{j}^{q}\right)^{1/q}.". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
